entry.title: Pragmatic definition of consensus for light clients
entry.summary:
The concept of the "heaviest chain" as a proxy for economic reality is intriguing, particularly in its function as a binding agent within economic systems. This term captures the essence of how economic actions and reactions are stabilized, despite not having coercive power similar to a magical incantation. It suggests that this concept serves more as a natural equilibrium or focal point, where diverse economic activities tend to converge, aligning with theories proposed by scholars like Thomas Schelling.
Understanding the heaviest chain's effectiveness hinges on the presence of a stable environment; chaos or significant disruptions can undermine its role as a reliable measure. In contexts devoid of turmoil, the heaviest chain provides a valuable lens through which economic predictability and behavior might be better understood and anticipated. This perspective could potentially lead to more robust economic models and forecasting methods, enhancing our ability to navigate complex economic landscapes.
